| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Wavelength** `wavelength` | 8 | 3 to 64 px | The wavelength 1 / f_0 at the center of the pass band, in pixels. |
| **Bandwidth ratio** `sigmaOnf` | 0.55 | 0.3 to 0.9 | The ratio sigma / f_0 of the log-Gaussian. 0.55 gives about 2 octaves, 0.75 about 1 octave. |
| **One direction** `oriented` | on | On or off | With this on, the filter keeps one direction of the spectrum. With it off, it keeps all directions. |
| **Angle** `angle` | 0 | 0 to 360 deg | The direction in which the wave changes, counterclockwise on screen. 0 finds vertical stripes. |
| **Angular spread** `angularSigma` | 25 | 5 to 90 deg | The standard deviation sigma_theta of the angular Gaussian. |
| **Output** `output` | Magnitude | Magnitude, Real part (lines), Imaginary part (edges) | Which part of the complex result to show, when the filter has one direction. |
| **Output mapping** `outputMapping` | Stretch to full range | Absolute value, Offset by 128, Stretch to full range, Clip to 0 to 255 | How signed results, such as gradients, become 8-bit pixel values. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
